stateKeys.name: hasResponse
stateKeys.type: boolean — true once at least one response chunk has been received for the in-flight prompt

stateKeys.name: endedVia
stateKeys.type: string, how the last prompt run ended: '' (none yet / in flight), 'completed', 'error', 'cancelled'

specialRules.name: compose-only-from-settled
specialRules.note: A new prompt may start composing only from idle, completed, or failed. Starting a new composition while one is in flight (composing/submitted/awaiting) is a reject — the UI must cancel or finish first.

specialRules.name: submit-only-from-composing
specialRules.note: SUBMIT_PROMPT is legal only while composing. Double-submit (already submitted/awaiting) is an observable reject, not a second CLI spawn.

specialRules.name: chunk-only-while-in-flight
specialRules.note: Response chunks are accepted only in submitted (first chunk) or awaiting (subsequent chunks). A late chunk arriving after completion, failure, or cancel is absorbed as a reject — post == pre.

specialRules.name: complete-only-from-awaiting
specialRules.note: Faithful to the legacy promptFsm: completion requires at least one chunk to have arrived (submitted -> awaiting on first chunk). A zero-chunk completion is a reject; callers that can complete chunklessly must emit their final payload as a chunk first.

specialRules.name: error-only-while-in-flight
specialRules.note: RESPONSE_ERROR applies only in submitted or awaiting. A late error after settle/cancel is absorbed as a reject.

specialRules.name: cancel-only-while-active
specialRules.note: CANCEL_PROMPT applies in composing, submitted, or awaiting, and always returns to idle with endedVia 'cancelled' (for submitted/awaiting) or '' (composing — nothing ran). Cancelling from idle/completed/failed is a reject.

noOpRule: An action that does not apply in the current state is reject(reason) — an observable no-op with post == pre, never a throw and never a silent return.
